title: MandatePay Mandate v1
description: Unsigned body of a mandate. The owner signs the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of this object with Ed25519; the signature travels beside it in a SignedMandate envelope (see gateway.openapi.yaml). Immutable once signed: to change anything, issue a new mandate that supersedes this one. Money is integer minor units (kobo for NGN). No floats anywhere in this object. Extra server-side rules that JSON Schema cannot express are listed in docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md section 4.2.

mandate_id.description: Generated client-side (mdt_ + ULID or UUID without dashes). Gateway rejects duplicates.

key_id.description: Owner key that signs this mandate. Must be registered to principal_id.

supersedes.description: Previous active mandate for the same agent, if any. It becomes 'superseded' when this one is accepted.

purpose.description: Human-readable intent shown in the UI. Never read by the policy engine.

payees.description: Allowlist of registered payee ids. Anything else is BLOCKed.

auto_max_minor.description: At or below this the agent may pay without asking (if no ASK rule fires).

hard_max_minor.description: Above this: always BLOCK. Between auto_max and hard_max: ASK. Must be >= auto_max_minor (checked server-side).

windows.description: Rolling windows. Spend = executed payments by this agent for this principal in the last `seconds`, across all mandates. A payment that would push spend above cap_minor is BLOCKed. Approvals cannot override a cap.

percent_of_average.description: ASK if amount > this % of the average of the last history_count executed payments to the same payee. Skipped until that many payments exist.

quarantine.description: If the agent collects this many BLOCK decisions within window_seconds, the mandate is quarantined: every otherwise-ALLOW payment becomes ASK until the owner releases it.

timestamp.description: UTC, whole seconds, always the trailing Z. Strict on purpose so canonical bytes match across languages.
